definition.numerator: Square of largest original max_abs across both ranks and all three raw groups; one occurrence only.
definition.denominator_total: Sum of both ranks original self_target/prior_source/other_policy sumsq.
definition.denominator_prior: Sum of both ranks original prior_source sumsq.
definition.interpretation: A lower bound on second-moment mass associated with extreme-value occurrences: at least one work-row token attains max_abs; ties or DP-duplicated occurrences are not added to the numerator.
